name: @plusguard/fit-more-nav
description: A row that always fits: menu items or tabs that don't fit move to a "More" dropdown, by priority, and come back as the row grows. The current one never hides. Completes @plusguard/dropdown (and target-functions for tabs). No dependencies.

scripts.build: npx -p typescript tsc index.ts --outDir dist --declaration --target es2020 --module es2020 --lib dom,dom.iterable,es2020 --strict

author: PlusGuard
